title: NASA mission controller tells of space program honouring 'sponsors' in second-century Latin

tellings.quote: Diana Pulka who talks to this NASA mission controller Tim Taylor and she talks about people in the quote unquote secret space program

plain: People in a "secret space program," a claimed hidden space effort apart from the public one, are said to honour certain "sponsors" in second-century Latin. Michels tells this himself, passing on what the scholar Diana Pasulka has said about her talks with a NASA mission controller named Timothy Taylor. If true, it would mean a hidden space effort with its own old rituals.
